observations: REAL INFERENCE RAN. Upstream llama.cpp b11125 (CPU only, -ngl 0) loaded SmolVLM-256M-Instruct-Q8_0.gguf + mmproj-SmolVLM-256M-Instruct-Q8_0.gguf and answered the image question correctly twice: green-circle.png -> 'Green', red-square.png -> 'Red'. So the vision-capable GGUF+mmproj pair genuinely accepts images.

REAL BACKEND, NO MOCKS. hub.utils.gguf.list_local_gguf_variants returned has_vision=true for the vision repo and has_vision=false for the text-only repo; utils.models.gguf_metadata.mmproj_accepts_image returned true for both real projectors; and the real coroutine behind GET /api/models/gguf-variants (hub.services.models.gguf_variants.get_gguf_variants_answer) answered with the same verdicts and resolved_locally=true.

THE BUG SHAPE IS REAL ON DISK. For the real vision repo the variant listing reports has_vision=true while the /api/models/list catalog row for the same directory reports isVision=false (utils.models.model_config.is_vision_model -> False). That stale/mismatched pair is exactly what the head's isKnownTextOnlySelection is written to survive.

BASE vs HEAD (measured cases). Base spuriously warns on the real vision quant (vision-gguf-local-picked-quant and vision-gguf-no-hint-yet-stale-catalog); head warns on neither. Head is correct on all 7 cases (6 measured on real weights + 1 derived); base_wrong_measured=2, head_wrong=0.

TEXT-ONLY NEGATIVE CONTROL. The same 270m text-only quant answers a text-only prompt (llama-completion, exit 0) but is refused for image input: llama-mtmd-cli exits 1 with 'Missing --mmproj argument', pairing it with the SmolVLM projector fails with 'mismatch between text model (n_embd = 640) and mmproj (n_embd = 576)', and the text-only runner rejects --image as 'invalid argument'.

HEAD NORMALIZER ON REAL PAYLOADS. Feeding the actual route payloads through the head's real normalizeGgufVisionCapability: the vision repo's has_vision=true normalizes to undefined (not a text-only claim) and does not warn; the text-only repo's has_vision=false survives as false and does warn. NORMALIZE_OK repos=2.

HONEST NON-DISCRIMINATION. On the real text-only directory base and head agree (both warn), because that directory's own catalog row is authoritative. The only text-only case where base misses the warning uses a derived stale is_vision=true catalog row, which was NOT observed in the staged weights; it is labelled derived-not-observed in the matrix and was not counted as measured.
limitations: NO STUDIO SERVER WAS LAUNCHED and no Studio HTTP endpoint or browser was used. The delegated constraint forbids launching independent servers, and the stage declares no environments, browsers or endpoints. The API-level check therefore ran the real route coroutine in-process rather than over a socket; the picker/composer UI path is the separate vision-ui stage.

NO GPU INFERENCE. nvidia-smi showed GPUs 0-6 at 78-99% utilisation with 136-169 GB already allocated by other workloads; GPU 7 was reportedly faulty. No reservation was held, so all inference was CPU-only with -ngl 0 and tiny 256M weights. Throughput numbers are not comparable to GPU runs and were not treated as performance evidence.

MODEL CHOICE. The 17.5 GB Qwen3.8-27B vision GGUF already on disk was probed for capability but not run; a separate 256M SmolVLM vision pair was downloaded specifically so real image inference would be affordable on CPU within the stage's 4096 MiB RAM and 3-thread envelope.

TOOLCHAIN IDENTITY. Inference used upstream llama.cpp b11125 (ubuntu-x64 CPU build, commit 94256114c) fetched into the task root, not the Studio-bundled build present on the host (version 0.4.1-dev build 11030). The bundled copy ships only llama-server, which the no-new-server constraint excluded.

The real Studio frontend bundle was not rebuilt or driven in this stage; base/head behaviour was compared between the pinned base gate source executed verbatim and the head's actual module, plus the real backend payloads they consume.
